note: Cherokee County SC parcels are published only via (1) the SCDOT-hosted SC_Parcels MapServer layer 10 ('Parcels - SC - Cherokee County'), which returns 'Token Required' to anonymous requests, and (2) the county's qPublic/Schneider viewer, which has no public REST endpoint. No public queryable parcel service for Cherokee County SC was found. The Gaffney city layer covers only the city; commercial downloads are not public services.
